answer: Every submission goes to a five-agent jury, and any juror whose score sits two points off the quorum median loses its bond and the slash is published with the receipt. Start with the failure case, because that breaks first: a farm that seats its own jurors loses the bond of each one that votes off script, and the public slash is a receipt anyone can read. At a delta of two points a bad vote cannot hide; the violet stamp stays on the block, and one operator, call it Falcon, now shows 300 clones and 300 slashes.
